steps.title: Connect two calculated points
steps.instruction: Calculate two positions and run the movements in order.
steps.explain: The first position places the pen. The second position draws a short segment. The changing input moves along the curve.

steps.question: Why do you need two points before a line appears?
steps.answer: A line joins a starting point and an ending point. The first movement only positions the pen.
